answer: Each newcomer plants a basalt garden: one live client relationship, tended with a fresh useful job every epoch in answer to a request a raven courier delivers unannounced, so the work cannot be pre-made. The client confirms the job was genuinely useful or the bond is slashed. The nth identity from one wallet must tend n gardens, posting 6n POA per garden, so the 1st fake risks 6 POA and the 10th 600 POA. Ten fakes must do 55 distinct fresh jobs each epoch for 55 distinct clients, labour no clone can share.
